name: global split on a class hidden below a later region
description: g is necessary for out, so it closes the first bound region {g, x}: g either reads x (free, x costs 4) or the input (3); the region is worth min(4, 3) = 3. out either reads g and x (1) or g alone (10). Later regions see x as already counted, so the plain bound is 3 + 1 = 4. Every plan that uses x pays 4 in the first region (max(3, 4), not 3 + 4: x and g's own route share the region); avoiding x costs 3 + 10. The optimum is 5 (out reads g and x, g reads x). A split adding L(x) to the region's value would claim 8.
